## Methods

The distribution of the outcome (2 categories) across 2 groups (n = 124) was tested with Pearson's chi-squared test (chi-square(1) = 5.63, P = 0.018). The odds ratio of non-responder for control versus treated was 2.39. Proportions are shown as a 100% stacked bar per group. Analyses were performed in Python 3.10.12 with scipy 1.15.3; the figure was produced with matplotlib 3.10.9.
